resources.string: Save your settings to a file and restore them on a new phone
A small file with all your choices: city, calculation, alerts, silence and appearance.
Choose where to save it, such as Google Drive or Downloads.
Couldn\'t save the file. Try another location.
Choose a Najwa file you saved earlier; your current settings will be replaced.
Settings restored and prayer times rescheduled.
This file isn\'t a valid Najwa settings backup.
The file doesn\'t include an adhan sound you imported, or phone permissions.
Battery saving may delay Najwa\'s alerts or stop auto silence. Let Najwa run without restrictions.
On Samsung: Settings › Device care › Battery › Background usage limits, and make sure Najwa isn\'t in “Sleeping apps” or “Deep sleeping apps”.
On Xiaomi: App info › Battery saver › No restrictions, and turn on Autostart.
On Huawei: Settings › Battery › App launch, set Najwa to “Manage manually” with every option on.
On OPPO, realme, OnePlus and vivo: App info › Battery usage › Allow background activity.
In the list choose “All apps”, then Najwa › “Don\'t optimize”. Najwa doesn\'t drain the battery; it only wakes at prayer times.
A short alert before prayer time, as many minutes ahead as you choose
No silence started; check it\'s on and the phone\'s mode
Sent; its record couldn\'t be saved
Permission or notification channel is off
Replaces Najwa\'s green with the Material You color from your wallpaper; the rest of the design stays.
“Alarms & reminders” is off: alerts arrive at approximate times and may be a few minutes late, and auto silence can\'t run.
If the month starts earlier or later in your country than the Umm al-Qura calendar, adjust by a day or two. It also affects Ramadan Isha in the Umm al-Qura method.
This date isn\'t available in the chosen time zone; check the location settings.
No sunrise or sunset on this date at your location; use a local calendar. Auto silence is paused.
Couldn\'t determine the length of the night; check a local calendar.
The date is outside the supported Hijri calendar.
Couldn\'t calculate Asr for this location.
The times overlap; check the calculation settings or minute adjustments.
Shows Dhuhr as Jumu\'ah on Fridays, with its own silence time
The sermon and prayer take longer, so choose the silence time from adhan.
Find my city from my location
Location permission wasn\'t granted. You can pick your city from the list.
Location isn\'t available. Turn on location services and try again.
Couldn\'t find your city. Choose from the list.
Includes this authority\'s official minute corrections.
No changes · match your mosque or local calendar
Add or subtract minutes for each time to match your local calendar. It applies to alerts, silence and the widget.
A gentle alert before adhan for the selected prayers

Najwa doesn\'t track your location. It\'s used once, only if you tap “Find my city”, to pick the nearest city; only the city you choose is saved and nothing leaves your phone. The app doesn\'t read contacts, messages or other apps\' notifications.
Hold the phone flat and turn until the arrow points to the Kaaba at the top.
%1$d° from true north · %2$s km to Makkah · %3$s
Your phone has no compass. The qibla is %1$d° from north; use a compass or the sun.
For accuracy: keep away from metal and magnets, and move the phone in a figure 8 if the direction seems unsteady.
The compass needs calibrating: move the phone in a figure 8 a few times.
Direction is calculated from the chosen city · change city
Couldn\'t read the ringer state; Najwa won\'t change the sound.
First allow ringer control and exact alarms from the Silence screen.
For a lesson or an extra prayer: silences the phone for %1$d minutes, then restores the ringer.
Add the “Najwa silence” button to Quick Settings: pull down the shade › Edit.
Choose the adhan you hear at prayer time. Tap “Listen” to preview.
MP3, M4A or WAV up to 32 MB
Adhan sound settings on the phone
The adhan plays at alarm volume; stop it with the “Stop adhan” button on the notification.
Your phone\'s time zone (%2$s) differs from %1$s. Tap to choose your current city so prayer times stay right.
